human_pressure.one_screen_brief: ClaimHelper dogfood found 65/84 exported runs with run_started but no run_completed/run_failed; 39 produced no consistency warning. Fix only this semantic hole: when a run has explicit start evidence but no terminal lifecycle evidence, Ailuros must deterministically surface an incomplete/unknown finding instead of appearing clean. Do not infer failure, timeout, root cause, or producer-specific behavior.
human_pressure.why_now: A governance export must not equate missing terminal evidence with absence of a problem. This is a direct production-evidence repair, not a new lifecycle subsystem.
do_not_misread: Do not convert missing terminal evidence into run_failed.
Do not add time-based stale-run heuristics.
Do not diagnose EverRun/backend/coder/planner causes from missing terminal evidence.
red_lines: No new lifecycle engine, watcher, scheduler, timeout monitor, persistence layer or producer-specific branch.
Do not change completed/failed semantics for runs that already have terminal evidence.
Unknown/incomplete must remain evidence semantics, not inferred business failure.

machine_core.goal: Make explicit run_started-without-terminal evidence visible as an incomplete/unknown governance finding while preserving all existing terminal lifecycle behavior.
invariants: run_completed remains completed and run_failed remains failed.
run_started without run_completed/run_failed never appears clean solely because no other warning exists.
Missing terminal evidence never fabricates failure, success, timeout or root cause.
Runs without run_started are not reclassified by this pack.

observable_effect.assertion: Explicit start evidence without terminal lifecycle evidence deterministically produces an incomplete/unknown finding and cannot be silently represented as clean.

proofs.assertion: run_started without terminal evidence surfaces the finding.
completed and failed runs retain their existing lifecycle/outcome behavior.
the repair does not infer failure/root cause/timeout from absence of terminal evidence.
the result is identical for equivalent normalized evidence from different source labels.

failure_semantics: Missing terminal evidence means incomplete/unknown evidence, not failed execution.
If start evidence itself is absent, preserve existing semantics rather than guessing a lifecycle.
If terminal evidence exists, it takes precedence over this missing-terminal condition.

steps.title: Locate the existing lifecycle consistency path
details: Reuse the current ExecutionProjection/Lifecycle and existing signal/finding path.
Do not introduce a parallel lifecycle representation.

steps.title: Surface missing terminal evidence
details: When normalized evidence proves run_started and proves neither run_completed nor run_failed, emit the smallest existing-compatible incomplete/unknown finding.
Keep the finding deterministic and source neutral.

steps.title: Lock regression semantics
details: Test started->completed, started->failed, started->missing-terminal and no-start cases.
Test equivalent evidence under at least two source labels to prevent EverRun-specific branching.

acceptance: A run with run_started and no run_completed/run_failed surfaces an incomplete/unknown finding.
The same run is not reclassified as failed, successful, timed out or assigned a root cause without evidence.
Existing completed and failed lifecycle behavior is unchanged.
Runs with no start evidence preserve existing behavior.
ruff, mypy and the full pytest suite pass.

must_check: The implementation reuses existing lifecycle/projection/finding primitives rather than creating a parallel lifecycle model.
run_started without terminal evidence produces a visible incomplete/unknown finding.
Completed and failed runs retain existing semantics.
No absence-based inference creates run_failed, timeout or a producer-specific root cause.
Equivalent normalized evidence yields equivalent results across source labels.
The full regression suite, ruff and mypy pass.
reject_if: Missing terminal evidence is converted to run_failed or success.
A stale-time threshold, watchdog, scheduler or lifecycle service is introduced.
The code branches on EverRun/ClaimHelper/vendor identity for this finding.
Validation fails or forbidden files change.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Missing run terminal evidence without failure inference.
missing_targets: tests/test_missing_run_terminal_evidence.py may be created by this pack
